title.narrative: Egyptian Electronics and Embedded Centres of Excellence (EEECoE)

description.narrative: The main objective of the project is to fostering the economic development of Egyptian electronics and embedded systems industries through the establishment of specialized centres of excellences in remote Egyptian areas [Upper Egypt, Delta and Borg Al-Arab] to increase the reach of eco-systems services to all Egyptian regions to fight poverty and unemployment. Specific Objectives: -Establishment and provisioning of 3 innovation hubs in upper Egypt, Delta and Northern region (Alexandria) to provide all services needed by innovators, start-ups and SMEs. -Provide ideation and entrepreneurship readiness programs to increase awareness and readiness of young innovators to start their own business, building their capacity through both technical and business trainings. -Creation of 3 incubation programs in these innovation hubs and incubate 15 electronic and embedded start-ups including seed funding. -Provide R&D facilities for MSMEs to improve their products and increase their competitiveness. -Engage both academia and private sector in innovation creation process to minimize the gap between the industry and research facilities.
